acid-arrow.note: On a hit it also takes 2d4 acid at the end of its next turn (+1d4 per slot level above 2); on a miss, half the initial damage only.

aid.note: Up to three creatures; each one's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points rise by 5 for 8 hours, +5 per slot level above 2.

alter-self.note: Natural Weapons option: your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 slashing, piercing or bludgeoning and use your spellcasting modifier for attack and damage.

animal-friendship.note: Beasts only; ends if you or an ally damages it; one more Beast per slot level above 1.

animal-messenger.note: Tiny Beast only (one with a Challenge Rating above 0 succeeds); on a failure it carries a 25-word message to the recipient you describe.

arcane-hand.note: Clenched Fist; other options: Forceful Hand (Str save or pushed), Grasping Hand (Dex save or Grappled, then a Bonus Action crush for 4d6 + mod bludgeoning, +2d6 per slot level above 5) or Interposing Hand; Bonus Action on later turns for up to 1 minute.

aura-of-life.note: For up to 10 minutes you and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have Resistance to necrotic and Hit Point maximums that can't be reduced; an ally starting its turn there at 0 Hit Points regains 1 Hit Point.

awaken.note: A Beast or Plant gains Intelligence 10 and a language; Charmed for 30 days or until you or allies damage it.

bane.note: Up to three targets; a target that fails subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls and saves for the duration; one more target per slot level above 1.

banishment.note: Sent to a harmless demiplane while it lasts; an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend doesn't return if it lasts the full minute; one more target per slot level above 4.

bestow-curse.note: One curse of your choice for 1 minute: Disadvantage on checks and saves with one ability, Disadvantage on attacks against you, a Wis save each turn or Dodge, or 1d8 extra necrotic when you damage it.

black-tentacles.note: Saves when it appears and when a creature enters or ends its turn there, once per turn; Difficult Terrain; an action and Strength (Athletics) check vs your DC ends the Restrained condition.

bless.note: Up to three creatures; one more per slot level above 1.

blight.note: A Plant creature automatically fails; a nonmagical plant simply withers and dies.

blindness-deafness.note: Deafened instead if you choose; repeats the save at the end of each of its turns; one more target per slot level above 2.

blink.note: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns; on 4-6 you go to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn.

burning-hands.note: Unattended flammable objects in the Cone start burning.

call-lightning.note: A bolt on casting, then again as a Magic action on later turns for up to 10 minutes; +1d10 if cast outdoors in a storm.

calm-emotions.note: Humanoids only; each gains Immunity to Charmed and Frightened (suppressing them) or becomes Indifferent toward creatures you choose until it or its allies take damage.

charm-monster.note: Advantage on the save if you or allies are fighting it; ends if you or allies damage it; one more target per slot level above 4.

charm-person.note: Humanoids only; Advantage on the save if you or allies are fighting it; ends if you or allies damage it; one more target per slot level above 1.

chill-touch.note: On a hit the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

chromatic-orb.note: If two or more d8s match, the orb leaps to another target within 30 feet (new attack and damage roll), up to slot-level leaps.

cloudkill.note: Triggers when it appears, when the Sphere moves into a creature's space and when a creature enters or ends its turn there, once per turn; it moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns; Heavily Obscured.

color-spray.note: Blinded until the end of your next turn.

command.note: On a failed save the target obeys a one-word command (Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel = Prone, Halt) on its next turn; one more target per slot level above 1.

compulsion.note: As a Bonus Action you name a horizontal direction; each Charmed target moves as far as it can that way on its next turn, then repeats the save.

cone-of-cold.note: A creature killed by it becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

confusion.note: A failure means no Bonus Actions or Reactions and a 1d10 roll at the start of each of its turns for its behavior; it repeats the save at the end of each turn; radius +5 feet per slot level above 4.

conjure-animals.note: You can force the save when the pack moves within 10 feet of a creature or a creature enters or ends its turn within 10 feet of it, once per turn, for up to 10 minutes.

conjure-elemental.note: When a creature enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it and the spirit restrains no one; the Restrained target saves at the start of each of its turns, taking 4d8 on a failure and breaking free on a success.

conjure-minor-elementals.note: Any attack you hit against a creature in your 15-foot Emanation, for up to 10 minutes; the ground there is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.

conjure-woodland-beings.note: Triggers when the Emanation enters a creature's space or it enters or ends its turn there, once per turn, for up to 10 minutes; you can Disengage as a Bonus Action.

contact-other-plane.note: Only to you, if you fail the DC 15 Intelligence save on casting, and you are then Incapacitated until a Long Rest; on a success you ask up to five questions.

contagion.note: While Poisoned it has Disadvantage on saves with an ability you choose; it repeats the save each turn until three successes (spell ends) or three failures (lasts 7 days).

control-water.note: Whirlpool effect only: a creature entering it for the first time on a turn or ending its turn there saves; other options flood, part or redirect water.

counterspell.note: On a failed save the spell fails and its action is wasted; a spell slot used for it isn't expended.

detect-thoughts.note: Only when you probe deeper: a failure reveals its reasoning and emotions, a success ends the spell.

dimension-door.note: Only if you or the creature with you would arrive in an occupied space; each of you takes it and the teleportation fails.

dispel-evil-and-good.note: Dismissal (Magic action, 5 feet) sends a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend or Undead home on a failure; those types have Disadvantage on attacks against you; Break Enchantment ends their charm, fear or possession.

dissonant-whispers.note: On a failed save the target uses its Reaction to move as far away from you as it can.

divine-favor.note: Applies to your weapon attack hits for 1 minute.

divine-smite.note: 1d8 more if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.

dominate-beast.note: Beasts only; Advantage on the save if you or allies are fighting it; repeats the save whenever it takes damage; lasts up to 10 minutes, 1 hour or 8 hours with a level 5, 6 or 7+ slot.

dominate-person.note: Humanoids only; Advantage on the save if you or allies are fighting it; repeats the save whenever it takes damage; lasts up to 10 minutes, 1 hour or 8 hours with a level 6, 7 or 8+ slot.

dragons-breath.note: The touched creature exhales as a Magic action on each of its turns for up to 1 minute; the type is chosen on casting.

dream.note: Only if you make the messenger terrifying; on a failure the target also gains no benefit from its rest and takes the damage when it wakes up.

enlarge-reduce.note: Only an unwilling creature saves; Enlarge gives Advantage on Strength checks and saves and +1d4 weapon damage, Reduce gives Disadvantage and -1d4.

ensnaring-strike.note: Cast on a weapon hit; Large or larger has Advantage. While Restrained it takes 1d6 piercing at the start of each of its turns (+1d6 per slot level above 1); a Strength (Athletics) check vs your DC ends it.

entangle.note: Area is Difficult Terrain; a Restrained creature can use an action for a Strength (Athletics) check vs your DC to break free.

enthrall.note: Creatures you or your companions are fighting succeed automatically; a failure gives -10 to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception.

faerie-fire.note: Affected creatures shed Dim Light, can't benefit from Invisible, and attack rolls against them have Advantage.

faithful-hound.note: At the start of each of your turns, for 8 hours, the hound bites one enemy within 5 feet of it; only you can see it.

fear.note: A failure also drops what it holds and Dashes away each turn; it saves again when it ends a turn out of your line of sight.

fire-bolt.note: An unattended flammable object hit starts burning.

fire-shield.note: Hits a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack, for 10 minutes; warm shield deals fire and resists cold, chill shield deals cold and resists fire.

fireball.note: Flammable objects in the area that aren't worn or carried start burning.

flame-blade.note: Each attack is a Magic action, for up to 10 minutes; the blade can be evoked again as a Bonus Action.

flaming-sphere.note: Triggers when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere or you roll it into its space (Bonus Action, 30 feet), for up to 1 minute.

geas.note: Charmed for 30 days (365 with a level 7 or 8 slot); it takes 5d10 psychic, at most once a day, when it acts directly against your command.

glyph-of-warding.note: Explosive rune when triggered; a spell glyph instead stores a spell of level 3 or lower (up to the slot level when upcast).

goodberry.note: Ten berries for 24 hours; a creature eats one as a Bonus Action to regain 1 Hit Point.

grease.note: Difficult Terrain for 1 minute; a creature entering or ending its turn there saves again or falls Prone.

guardian-of-faith.note: Enemies only, when one moves there for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, for 8 hours; the guardian vanishes after dealing 60 damage in total.

guidance.note: The 1d4 applies only to ability checks with the chosen skill.

guiding-bolt.note: The next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

gust-of-wind.note: A failure pushes it 15 feet away; it saves again when ending its turn in the Line; moving toward you costs double.

haste.note: Doubled Speed, +2 AC, Advantage on Dex saves and a limited extra action; when it ends the target is Incapacitated with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn.

heat-metal.note: Again as a Bonus Action on later turns for up to 1 minute; a holder or wearer makes a Con save or drops it, else Disadvantage on attacks and checks until the start of your next turn.

hellish-rebuke.note: Reaction against the creature that damaged you.

heroism.note: Target is immune to Frightened and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns; one more target per slot level above 1.

hex.note: Target has Disadvantage on checks with one chosen ability; the curse can move to a new creature if the target drops to 0 Hit Points.

hideous-laughter.note: Repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and when it takes damage (with Advantage); one more target per slot level above 1.

hold-monster.note: Repeats the save at the end of each of its turns; one more creature per slot level above 5.

hold-person.note: Humanoids only; repeats the save at the end of each of its turns; one more Humanoid per slot level above 2.

hunters-mark.note: Advantage on Perception or Survival checks to find the target; the mark can move if the target drops to 0 Hit Points.

hypnotic-pattern.note: Speed 0 while Charmed; ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken out of it with an action.

ice-knife.note: Hit or miss, the target and each creature within 5 feet make a Dex save or take 2d6 cold (+1d6 per slot level above 1).

ice-storm.note: The ground there is Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.

insect-plague.note: Triggers when the swarm appears and when a creature first enters it on a turn or ends its turn there, once per turn, for up to 10 minutes; Lightly Obscured, Difficult Terrain.

invisibility.note: Ends after the target attacks, deals damage or casts a spell; one more target per slot level above 2.

levitate.note: Only an unwilling creature saves; it rises up to 20 feet and you can move it 20 feet up or down on your turn.

magic-circle.note: Only when a creature of a chosen type tries to teleport into (or out of) the Cylinder; it also has Disadvantage on attacks across it and can't charm, frighten or possess those inside.

mass-cure-wounds.note: Up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere.

mass-healing-word.note: Up to six creatures you can see.

meld-into-stone.note: Only to you, if the stone is partly destroyed or reshaped; complete destruction deals 50 force instead; either way you are expelled Prone.

mind-spike.note: On a failure you know its location for up to 1 hour, and it can't hide from you or benefit from Invisible against you.

mislead.note: You turn Invisible and an illusory double appears; the invisibility ends right after you attack, deal damage or cast a spell.

modify-memory.note: Advantage on the save if you are fighting it; ends if it takes damage or is targeted by another spell; lets you rewrite its memory of a recent event.

moonbeam.note: Triggers when it appears, when moved onto a creature (Magic action, 60 feet) and when a creature enters or ends its turn there, once per turn; shape-shifters revert on a failure.

phantasmal-force.note: The 2d8 comes on each of your turns, with no new save, while the target is in or within 5 feet of a harmful phantasm; an Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your DC ends it.

phantasmal-killer.note: A success ends the spell; a failure gives Disadvantage on checks and attacks and a new save at the end of each of its turns, full damage again on a failure, ending on a success.

planar-binding.note: A Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend that fails is bound to serve you for 24 hours, longer with a higher slot.

polymorph.note: Turns it into a Beast of your choice with a Challenge Rating up to its own for up to 1 hour; it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the form's Hit Points and reverts when they run out.

prayer-of-healing.note: Up to five creatures, who also gain the benefits of a Short Rest; once per creature until it finishes a Long Rest.

produce-flame.note: The flame lasts 10 minutes; each hurl is a Magic action.

ray-of-enfeeblement.note: A failure gives Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and -1d8 on its damage rolls, saving again at the end of each turn; a success gives Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

ray-of-frost.note: On a hit the target's Speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

ray-of-sickness.note: Poisoned until the end of your next turn.

reincarnate.note: Roll 1d10 for the new body's species (1 roll again, 2 Dragonborn, 3 Dwarf, 4 Elf, 5 Gnome, 6 Goliath, 7 Halfling, 8 Human, 9 Orc, 10 Tiefling) or the GM picks one.

resilient-sphere.note: Only an unwilling creature saves; it is enclosed for up to 1 minute, and nothing passes in or out or damages across the barrier.

resistance.note: Once per turn, damage of the chosen type to the target is reduced by 1d4.

sacred-flame.note: The target gains no benefit from Half or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.

sanctuary.note: A creature targeting the warded creature with an attack or damaging spell makes a Wisdom save or must pick a new target or lose it; ends if the warded creature attacks, casts or deals damage.

scrying.note: The save is modified by how well you know the target and your connection to it; on a success you can't scry it again for 24 hours.

searing-smite.note: At the start of each of its turns the target takes the fire damage again, then makes a Con save; a success ends the spell.

seeming.note: Only an unwilling creature saves; a Study action and Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your DC sees through the disguise.

shatter.note: Constructs have Disadvantage on the save; unattended nonmagical objects in the area also take the damage.

shillelagh.note: Club or Quarterstaff uses your spellcasting ability and a d8 die (Force or normal type); the die becomes d10, d12, 2d6 at levels 5, 11, 17.

shining-smite.note: For up to 1 minute the target sheds light, attack rolls against it have Advantage and it can't benefit from Invisible.

shocking-grasp.note: On a hit the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

silence.note: Deafened only while entirely inside; Immunity to Thunder damage there and no spells with a Verbal component.

sleep.note: A target that fails repeats the save at the end of its next turn and falls Unconscious on a second failure; damage or a shake ends it.

sleet-storm.note: Saves on first entering on a turn or starting its turn there; a failure also breaks Concentration; Heavily Obscured, Difficult Terrain.

slow.note: Up to six creatures: halved Speed, -2 to AC and Dex saves, no Reactions, an action or a Bonus Action only; repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

sorcerous-burst.note: Each 8 rolled adds another d8, up to your spellcasting modifier in extra dice.

spike-growth.note: Per 5 feet a creature moves in the area, for up to 10 minutes; hidden unless seen during casting or found with a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check.

spirit-guardians.note: Necrotic only if you are evil; triggers when the Emanation enters a creature's space or it enters or ends its turn there, once per turn; Speed halved inside.

spiritual-weapon.note: Bonus Action on later turns to move it 20 feet and attack again, for up to 1 minute.

starry-wisp.note: Until the end of your next turn the target sheds Dim Light and can't benefit from Invisible.

stinking-cloud.note: Saves at the start of each turn in the cloud; Poisoned only until the end of that turn, with no action or Bonus Action.

suggestion.note: It pursues a suggested course of up to 25 words for up to 8 hours; ends if you or your allies damage it.

telekinesis.note: On a failure you move it up to 30 feet and it is Restrained until the end of your next turn; again as a Magic action on later turns for up to 10 minutes.

thunderwave.note: On a failed save a creature is pushed 10 feet away.

true-strike.note: One weapon attack using your spellcasting ability, Radiant or normal type; extra 1d6/2d6/3d6 radiant at levels 5/11/17.

vampiric-touch.note: You regain Hit Points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt; attack again as a Magic action each turn for up to 1 minute.

vicious-mockery.note: On a failed save the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

vitriolic-sphere.note: On a failed save it also takes 5d4 acid at the end of its next turn.

wall-of-fire.note: The save is only when the wall appears; later, for up to 1 minute, a creature takes the damage with no save when it ends its turn within 10 feet of your chosen side or inside, or first enters the wall on a turn.

wall-of-stone.note: Only a creature the wall would enclose saves; on a success it can use its Reaction to move out.

web.note: Saves on first entering on a turn or starting its turn there; an action and Strength (Athletics) check vs your DC frees it; burning webs deal 2d4 fire.

wind-wall.note: Damage only when the wall appears; for up to 1 minute it blocks gases, ordinary arrows and bolts, and Small or smaller fliers.

zone-of-truth.note: Saves on first entering on a turn or starting its turn there; on a failure it can't speak a deliberate lie, and you know the result.
